# Add initGenesisFromAncestry mode to fuzz target

## Pull Request by @mateuszsikora

I added `--init-genesis-from-ancestry` mode to accept traces converted into fuzz messages from this repo: https://github.com/FluffyLabs/picofuzz-conformance-data

## Walkthrough

This change introduces an initGenesisFromAncestry boolean flag parsed from the CLI and propagated through jam/index -> mainFuzz -> mainImporter -> createImporter -> Importer. Types and function signatures are extended (Arguments, FuzzConfig, ImporterOptions/CreateImporterOptions, InitDbOptions). initializeDatabase may use an ancestry-derived initial block hash when the flag is set. Importer passes the flag to verifier.verifyBlock as skipParentAndStateRoot to alter block verification behavior.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes

## Possibly related PRs

- FluffyLabs/typeberry#450: Adds a verification-bypass option and threads it into importer verification calls.  
- FluffyLabs/typeberry#627: Modifies importer constructor/signatures and verification-related control flow.  
- FluffyLabs/typeberry#590: Adjusts fuzz-target / main-importer initialization flow impacting the same fuzz setup path.
